banter.a: Soup's nearly ready. Who's on bowls?
banter.b: I washed them this morning. Ladle's yours.

banter.a: The mites got into the east corridor again.
banter.b: I'll tell the fighters. They love mite season.

banter.a: Remember when this floor had a landlord?
banter.b: Barely. The garden grew right over his office.

banter.a: New verse for the fire tonight?
banter.b: Only if you harmonize this time.
On what? We don't pay him. Nobody pays him.

banter.a: Somebody left three potions in the share box.
banter.b: And somebody else will need exactly three. It works.

banter.a: The wraith tried to schedule a meeting with me.
banter.b: I hope you declined without comment.

banter.a: Teach-in at the fire after supper?
Kass took a dent for a stranger today.
banter.b: That's the job. That's the whole job.

banter.a: The tomatoes are winning against the slime.
banter.b: Never doubted them. Fierce little collectivists.

banter.a: Heard the boss floor's portrait gallery doubled.
We should widen the safe room. More travelers lately.
banter.b: I'll draw plans. The commune builds Sunday.

banter.a: A skeleton wandered close, then just... sighed.
banter.b: Even they know. Poor souls signed terrible contracts.

banter.a: Someone new read the wall today and just stood there.
banter.b: That's how it starts. That's exactly how it starts.
Picket-line strength. As the ancestors brewed.

banter.a: The bard taught the fighters a marching song.
banter.b: I heard. The rats upstairs are terrified of 4/4 time.

banter.a: Sold out of boots at the co-op again.
banter.b: Good. Means people are going places.

banter.a: One day we'll garden on the surface again.
banter.b: One day soon. Keep your seeds ready.
